protocol.name: helix_window_list_v1

description.summary: the open windows, for the Helix shell

protocol.description: A private protocol between the Helix compositor and the Helix shell, so the shell can show a window switcher and list open windows. In GNOME the shell and the compositor are one process; in Helix they are separate. The global is only advertised to privileged clients (the shell the compositor launched itself).

interface.name: helix_window_list_v1
interface.description: Right after binding, the compositor sends a window event for every open window, topmost first, then a focused event (and, since version 2, a workspaces event and a workspace event per window). Later events follow changes. Window ids are never reused. Workspaces are numbered from 0.

description.summary: a window appeared, or its app id or title changed
the window with keyboard focus (0: none)

request.name: activate
request.description: Brings the window back if it was minimized. Unknown ids are ignored.

description.summary: how many workspaces there are, and the active one

event.name: workspace

description.summary: the workspace a window is on

event.description: Sent after the window's window event, and whenever it changes. 0xffffffff means every workspace.

request.name: switch_workspace

description.summary: make a workspace the active one

request.description: Out of range numbers are ignored.

request.name: set_on_all_workspaces

description.summary: show a window on every workspace, or not

request.description: Turned off, the window belongs to the active workspace. Unknown ids are ignored.

request.name: move_window

description.summary: put a window on a workspace

request.description: The window stays where it is on screen; it is hidden if the workspace is not the active one. Unknown ids and out of range numbers are ignored.

enum.name: action
enum.description: See helix-desktop-spec contracts/wayland/README.md, "Window menu and window keys".

entry.name: wait
entry.summary: keep waiting for an unresponsive app (since 5)

request.name: window_action
request.description: Do action to window id, or to the focused window when id is 0. show_menu makes the compositor send a menu event.

entry.name: monitor_left
entry.summary: there is a monitor to the left

event.name: not_responding
event.description: The app of window id did not answer a ping in time (responding 0), or answered after all (responding 1).

event.name: shortcuts_inhibit

description.summary: an app asks for all keyboard shortcuts

event.description: Window id asks to get all keyboard shortcuts while it has keyboard focus (zwp_keyboard_shortcuts_inhibit_manager_v1). Answer with allow_shortcuts_inhibit; until then it does not get them.

request.name: allow_shortcuts_inhibit
request.description: Whether window id may get all keyboard shortcuts (allowed 1) or not (0).

event.name: icon

description.summary: the icon a window's app set

event.description: Window id's own icon (xdg_toplevel_icon_v1): an icon theme name (empty for none) and, when size is not 0, a size×size image in data (premultiplied ARGB8888 in native byte order, rows without padding). Sent when it changes, and for windows that have one when the list is first sent. A window without its own icon (name empty, size 0) uses its app's icon.

event.name: menu
event.description: Show the window menu of window id at x, y (layout coordinates, logical pixels). state describes the window, for the entries.
